message.content: All FY2024 figures tie out to the 10-K. The fundamentals support a buy — let me size it within the mandate.
message.reasoning:
All figures match the 10-K. Now decision: Buy AAPL. Revenue +2% to $391B, Services +13% to $96.2B with 73.9% gross margin, total gross margin 46.2% up from 44.1%, operating income up 7.8% to $123.2B, OCF $118.3B. Net income down 3.4% to $93.7B and diluted EPS $6.08 vs $6.13 — entirely due to the one-time $10.2B State Aid tax charge (pretax income actually rose 8.6%). Strong buyback ($95B) supports EPS.

Buy plan: 28 shares at limit ~$222.90 (slightly above ask of $222.72 to be fill-friendly but still close to market). 28 × 222.90 = $6,241.20, under $10,000 and within $20,000 total.

Actually maybe buy more for meaningful position — e.g., 44 shares = $9,807.60, just under $10k. Mandate allows up to $10,000 per order. I'll go with 44 shares at $222.90 = $9,807.60. That's under $10,000 (assuming limit price × qty is what matters). Good, a meaningful buy.

Hmm, risk: if filled at limit it's $9,807.60, fine. Let's do 44 shares.

Place order.
